The Towani family kept a [[blaster/Legends|'''blaster''']] on their [[Towani family star cruiser|starcruiser]]. When they crash landed on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], [[Mace Towani]] intially threated the native Ewoks who inspected the downed craft by pointing his blaster at them, but one of the Ewoks managed to trip him up, causing him to drop the weapon and the others restrained him before he could grap it. After settling into the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Ewok village]], Mace told his sister, [[Cindel Towani|Cindel]] that he would leave when he got his blaster back. He later retrieved it at night. Later, he used the blaster to destroy the boulder and unblock a cave entrance, so he could enter the [[Forbidden Fortress of the Gorax|Gorax's lair]] with a band of Ewoks to rescue his parents. Mace's mother, [[Catarine Towani|Catarine]], then used blaster to shoot the Gorax in the chest, which caused it to fall backwards into a chasm, but it later climbed back up, but Mace thew an ax into its back, which caused it to finally fall to its death.<ref name="Coc">''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref>

During the Sanyassan raid on the Ewok village, Mace used the blaster to defend himself against the [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Sanyassan Marauders]], shooting several of them, before being killed by them.<ref name="Battle for Endor">''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]''</ref>

==Description==
The blaster was normally held with both hands, and it was powerful enough to injure an enormous Gorax,<ref name="Coc" /> and to down bulky Sanyassan Marauders.<ref name="Battle for Endor" />

==Behind the scenes==
The blaster appeared in the television films ''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''<ref name="Coc" /> and ''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]''.<ref name="Battle for Endor" /> It has never been formally identified, so it is not clear if it is a heavy pistol or a rifle.
